name: Geerling llama.cpp Vulkan on rtx2080ti (pi host): deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-14b Q4_K_M tg128 24.63 tok/s
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Jeff Geerling, geerlingguy/ai-benchmarks). llama.cpp build f9ec8858e (7474), backend Vulkan, default llama-bench flags (ngl 99). Host: Raspberry Pi CM5 16GB, Pi OS Trixie, PCIe-attached card. Model file size 8.37 GiB, 14.77 B params, Q4_K_M. tg128 mean decode tok/s, per-request, batch 1, generation length 128. NOT aggregate. Whole-system wall power during the run 83.6 W (node scope, not device).
notes: Source issue prints the llama-bench mean and the +/- spread; the stored value is the mean. The Pi-host rows are the same physical GPU on a PCIe-constrained host, so they are not a card ceiling.
